p: Levin made his first start on the offensive line and mostly played acceptably
The line was a problem with penalties, so his hold on a starting spot is uncertain, and the coach said he will examine personnel.
by and large those guys did their job
Corey Levin will start at center after Ryan Neuzil's trade.
A new center on the line is a mild risk for pass protection and run blocking against a good Chiefs front.
I feel really good about his understanding of everything we're doing.
